updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
Release 3.2.0.0 
 - Move VKB BRA/BE display ribbon down on EFB map in both portrait and landscape orientations. 
 - VKB tab rail handling in landscape orientation on small devices now scales correctly. 
 - VKB FLT PLN tab NAVLOG column scaling now has minimum width for readability and, if required, adds a horizontal table position bar at the bottom of NAVLOG (iPad mini). 
 - DIR TO/DEL STP now works similar to Alt/SPD popup edits: single-click STP number, select required mode to arm, then click desired DIR TO STP or STP to delete. 
 - Fix VKB NAVLOG metric units handling.
 - Fix last deleted F10 marker remaining in VKB map markers list and on EFB moving map. 
 - Add protection against slow DCS module disconnect and retry if reconnect fails the first time due to socket not being released. 
 - Fix F-14B LANTIRN commands and move to proxy commands going forward. 
 - Add new F-14B(U) wheel visibility external plugin context commands. 
 - Add VKB stores pylon numbering for F-14, F-16, and A-10C. 
 - Add new in-game VAICOM PTT overlay display. 
 - VKB F-4E AI CREW keywords now have segments. 
 - Add VKB Digital Elevation Model (DEM) with 30 m resolution terrain data. 
 - VKB user waypoints now access DEM and add elevation data on creation. 
 - VKB EFB moving map now displays MORA at top-left, indicating highest terrain within a 40 nm radius (ICAO buffers applied). 
 - Add VKB MSA auto calculations to doghouses via DEM: 5 nm each side of route +1000 ft buffer. 
 - Add more custom stores pages for AH-64D and F-4E. 
 - Add global radial keyboard and calculator popup; allows send to any highlighted field in DCS. 
 - Anchor moving map draw layer to map background; all other draw canvas behavior unchanged. 
 - Add "Jester Context" special command to open Jester Wheel to context menu, not main menu. 
 - VKB moving map draw canvas now caches draw strokes and points so load is reduced on redraw with complex drawings and many layers open. 
 - Fix delay in VAICOM UI opening due to host and LAN checks. 
 - Reduce log spam on VAICOM UI Open command. 
 - Add new RadioCommandDialogsPanel.lua code insertion mechanics, non-destructive to other applications' code appendices. 
 - Refactor VKB bridge to facilitate future optionality, no functional changes. 
 - Fix legacy kneeboard call failing and now allow multiple attempts. 
 - Fix George AI keywords being duplicated with Gunner. 
 - Add keywords for Show/Hide VAICOM Overlay. 
 - Fix VKB moving map doghouses on reciprocal legs conflicting. 
 - Fix Navigraph token refresh and chart-unavailable log messages to be more user-friendly and less confusing. 
 - Fix F14 proxy_device restore when F-14 Mini Wheel is unchecked.
